_: Programs that are KNOWN red, and the exact diagnostic codes each must fail with.
This file INVERTS an assertion; it never removes one. A recorded program is still
expanded and still judged, and three things are findings: it passes (the record has
expired), it fails with a different code (a second defect was hiding behind the first),
or it fails with one more. A plain skip would be satisfied by the very defect it
excuses, which is the vacuity mode this project has shipped six times.
An entry belongs here only while a CAPABILITY the zone needs is missing from the
engine, and it names that capability in words a later session can act on. A defect a
session could fix today is fixed today; it does not become a record.
Ids are audit labels, so both corpora are recordable here: `library/<program>` for the
rule library this repo owns, `<campaign>/<zone>` for a campaign's zone programs.
Every campaign zone program of every campaign expands and judges green. The rule

exclusion.capability_gap: `causeway` floods its ward from floor to ceiling on both flanks of a 1-wide raised spine, and `fluid-contained` refuses that body of water: 134 of its 252 cells run into open air, 36 run directions leave the piece's own faces, and nothing in these bytes decides where that water goes. The repair is a contained ward — a lowered waterline with a wall under it — and it is now SAFE to make, which it was not before: `nav` used to read any non-air cell as floor, so lowering the waterline would have left a body-height air pocket the walk called a walkable surface and the ward's whole claim would have gone green while being false. That is fixed (a fluid is not a floor), so what remains here is a piece to repair rather than a capability to build, and this entry expires with the round that repairs it.
